natural: I have read your fine work with respect

meaning.en: A respectful way to say you have read someone's writing.
meaning.zh: 对读过对方文章或著作的敬辞。

equivalents: I have had the honour of reading your work
I read your masterpiece with respect

examples.zh: 早就拜读大作，受益匪浅。
examples.en: I read your fine work long ago and benefited greatly.

examples.zh: 昨晚拜读大作，十分佩服。
examples.en: Last night I read your piece and admire it greatly.

usage.en: 敬辞 (拜读, 大作) about the other's work. Can be flattering or, said with a smile, ironic. Formal; common in letters and literary circles.
usage.zh: 敬辞：“拜读”“大作”均指对方。可以是诚意恭维，也可含笑反语。正式，常见于书信和文化圈。

natural: there is no need to stand on ceremony

meaning.en: A polite reply to thanks or an offer, meaning 'don't mention it' or 'make yourself at home'.
meaning.zh: 对别人道谢或客套的回答，意思是“别客气”。

equivalents: no need to be so polite

examples.zh: 谢谢您帮忙！——不必客气。
examples.en: Thanks for helping! -- Don't mention it.

examples.zh: 来了就当自己家一样，不必客气。
examples.en: Treat this as your own home; no need to be formal.

usage.en: Used both as a reply to thanks and as an invitation to relax. Neutral; similar to 别客气 and 不用谢, but a touch more formal.
usage.zh: 既用来回应道谢，也用来请客人随意。中性，与“别客气”“不用谢”相近，稍正式。

meaning.en: A formal New Year greeting congratulating someone on the new year's joy.
meaning.zh: 正式的新年祝辞，祝贺新年喜庆。

equivalents: wishing you a joyful new year

examples.zh: 春联横批写着“恭贺新禧”。
examples.en: The horizontal scroll says 'Happy New Year'.

examples.zh: 公司向全体客户拜年：恭贺新禧！
examples.en: The company sends New Year greetings to all customers: Happy New Year!

usage.en: A fixed Spring Festival greeting on cards, couplet scrolls and shop signs. Formal and cheerful; 新禧 means 'new joy'. Often with 万事如意.
usage.zh: 春节固定祝辞，见于贺卡、春联和店铺招牌。正式喜庆；“新禧”即新年的喜庆。常与“万事如意”连用。

meaning.en: A Spring Festival greeting wishing someone a prosperous year.
meaning.zh: 春节祝福语，祝对方新年发大财。

examples.zh: 见面第一句就是“恭喜发财，红包拿来！”
examples.en: The first thing he said was 'Wishing you riches, now hand over a red envelope!'

examples.zh: 大年初一，邻居们互相说“恭喜发财”。
examples.en: On New Year's Day the neighbours greet each other with 'Wishing you prosperity'.

usage.en: A set greeting: said at Chinese New Year, especially in Cantonese-speaking regions (Gung hei fat choy), and when opening a business. Cheerful and casual.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：春节常说，尤其是在粤语地区，开业时也说。喜庆，口语。

meaning.en: A very common wish for someone to stay healthy.
meaning.zh: 最常用的祝愿语之一，祝对方健康。

examples.zh: 祝您身体健康，万事如意！
examples.en: Wishing you good health and all the best!

examples.zh: 年纪大了，最重要的是身体健康。
examples.en: At our age, good health matters most.

usage.en: A set greeting: a toast or closing line in cards and letters, especially to elders; also an ordinary phrase meaning 'being healthy'. Neutral.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：贺卡、书信和祝酒的常用结语，尤其对长辈；也可作普通短语，意为“身体好”。中性。

meaning.en: A formal wish for a family to be happy.
meaning.zh: 祝愿全家幸福的正式祝辞。

equivalents: wishing your family all the best

examples.zh: 祝您阖家幸福，新年快乐！
examples.en: Wishing you and your family happiness and a happy New Year!

examples.zh: 愿天下有情人阖家幸福。
examples.en: May couples everywhere enjoy a happy family life.

usage.en: A set greeting: said at New Year, Mid-Autumn and other family festivals, in cards and messages. Formal and warm; 阖 is written 阖, not 合, in careful writing.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：用于春节、中秋等家庭节日，见于贺卡和短信。正式温暖；讲究的写法用“阖”。

meaning.en: A wish that the whole family enjoys happiness together, often at festivals.

examples.zh: 祝大家春节合家欢乐！
examples.en: Wishing everyone family joy at Spring Festival!

examples.zh: 这部电影适合合家欢乐一起看。
examples.en: This film is good for the whole family to enjoy together.

usage.en: A set greeting: said at festivals; also describes family entertainment ('a family film'). Both 合家 and 阖家 are used; 阖家 is the more formal form. Neutral.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：节日祝辞；也可形容适合全家观看的娱乐。“合家”“阖家”都有人用，“阖家”更正式。中性。

meaning.en: A wish for a family to live in harmony.
meaning.zh: 祝愿家庭成员和睦相处。

examples.zh: 祝你们家庭和睦，白头偕老。
examples.en: May your family be harmonious and may you grow old together.

examples.zh: 家庭和睦是孩子成长的基础。
examples.en: A harmonious family is the foundation of a child's growth.

usage.en: A set greeting: also an ordinary description in essays and community slogans ('harmonious families'). Neutral, formal tone in writing.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：也是作文和社区标语中的普通描述语。中性，书面偏正式。

natural: blessed with both happiness and long life

meaning.en: A wish that an elder enjoy both good fortune and a long life.
meaning.zh: 祝愿老人既有福气又长寿。

examples.zh: 恭祝老人家福寿双全！
examples.en: We wish the old gentleman both happiness and long life!

examples.zh: 爷爷八十大寿，贺词是“福寿双全”。
examples.en: For grandpa's eightieth birthday, the greeting was 'happiness and long life'.

usage.en: A set greeting: a birthday wish for the elderly, in couplets and banners. Formal. 福 and 寿 are two of the three classic blessings (福禄寿).
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：给老人祝寿的话，见于对联和寿幛。正式。“福”“寿”是福禄寿三星之二。

natural: happiness, long life and good health

meaning.en: A wish for an elder to be happy, long-lived and healthy.
meaning.zh: 祝愿长辈幸福、长寿、平安健康。

equivalents: wishing you a long, healthy life

examples.zh: 祝奶奶福寿安康！
examples.en: Wishing grandma happiness, long life and health!

examples.zh: 贺卡上写着“福寿安康”四个大字。
examples.en: The card bore the four big characters for 'happiness, long life and health'.

usage.en: A set greeting: sent to elders at New Year, Double Ninth and birthdays. Formal, warm.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：春节、重阳和生日时送给长辈。正式亲切。

meaning.en: A wish that an elder's blessings and years will continue for a long time.
meaning.zh: 祝愿长辈福气和寿数绵延长久。

equivalents: may your happiness and years be long

examples.zh: 恭祝寿星福寿绵长。
examples.en: We wish the birthday star lasting happiness and long life.

examples.zh: 红纸上写着“福寿绵长”。
examples.en: 'Lasting happiness and long life' was written on the red paper.

usage.en: A set greeting: a formal birthday and Double Ninth wish. Rarer than 福寿安康 and quite literary.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：正式的祝寿和重阳祝辞，比“福寿安康”少见，偏书面。

meaning.en: A wish for happiness and for more years to be added to one's life.

examples.zh: 家人送上寿匾：福寿延年。
examples.en: The family presented a birthday plaque reading 'Happiness and Long Life'.

examples.zh: 愿您福寿延年，儿孙满堂。
examples.en: May you enjoy happiness, long life and a house full of descendants.

usage.en: A set greeting: a traditional blessing on birthday plaques and couplets. Literary; sounds old-fashioned in casual messages.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：传统的祝寿匾联用语。偏书面，在随意的信息里显得古雅。

meaning.en: A wish for plenty of good fortune and a long life.

equivalents: lots of blessings and long life
may you be blessed and live long

examples.zh: 给大伙儿拜年了，多福多寿！
examples.en: Happy New Year to you all, may you live long and be blessed!

examples.zh: 老人家多福多寿，儿孙孝顺。
examples.en: The old couple are blessed and long-lived with dutiful children.

usage.en: A set greeting: said at New Year and birthdays, and on peach-shaped buns or festive pictures. Cheerful, casual to neutral. Often 多子多福多寿 in older texts.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：春节和寿辰时说，也见于寿桃和年画。喜庆，口语到中性。旧时常说“多子多福多寿”。

natural: may you live as long as the tortoise and crane

meaning.en: A wish for a very long life, as long as the legendary lifespans of the tortoise and crane.
meaning.zh: 祝愿像龟和鹤那样长寿。

equivalents: may you live as long as the tortoise and crane

examples.zh: 祝老先生龟鹤齐龄。
examples.en: We wish the old gentleman a life as long as the tortoise and crane.

examples.zh: 寿堂上挂着“龟鹤齐龄”的横幅。
examples.en: A banner reading 'long as tortoise and crane' hung in the birthday hall.

usage.en: A set greeting: the tortoise and crane are Chinese symbols of longevity. Used on birthday scrolls for the elderly; literary and rarely spoken today.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：龟和鹤在中国文化中象征长寿。用于给老人祝寿的字幅；偏书面，今天很少口说。

meaning.en: A wish for a long life, taking the crane as the symbol of longevity.
meaning.zh: 以鹤为长寿象征，祝人寿命绵长。

equivalents: a crane's long life to you

examples.zh: 他送给老师一幅字：鹤寿延年。
examples.en: He gave his teacher a calligraphy scroll reading 'long life like the crane'.

examples.zh: 祝您鹤寿延年，身体康泰。
examples.en: May you have a crane's long life and good health.

usage.en: A set greeting: a birthday blessing for the elderly. Literary; the crane is said to live a thousand years.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：给老人的祝寿辞。偏书面；传说鹤能活千年。

meaning.en: A wish for someone to be safe and happy.

examples.zh: 祝你们平安喜乐，一生顺遂。
examples.en: May you have peace and joy and a smooth life.

examples.zh: 新年愿望只有一个：全家平安喜乐。
examples.en: My only New Year's wish is peace and joy for the whole family.

usage.en: A set greeting: fits any festival, birthday or farewell; popular in modern messages and blessings with a slightly Buddhist-sounding tone. Neutral.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：适合任何节日、生日或送别，在现代祝福语中很流行，略带佛家色彩。中性。

meaning.en: The standard greeting for the new year, both on 1 January and at Spring Festival.
meaning.zh: 新年的通用祝辞，元旦和春节都用。

equivalents: best wishes for the new year

examples.zh: 零点一过，大家都发消息说“新年快乐”。
examples.en: As soon as midnight passed, everybody sent messages saying 'Happy New Year'.

examples.zh: 祝同学们新年快乐，学习进步！
examples.en: Happy New Year to you all, and may your studies go well!

usage.en: A set greeting: the everyday, neutral New Year wish; 恭贺新禧 is more formal and 新春快乐 is mainly for Spring Festival.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：日常、中性的新年祝辞；“恭贺新禧”更正式，“新春快乐”主要用于春节。
